method: Full-page PNG inspection at 1.7x, checking headers/units/footnotes, followed by first/middle/last rows in each of 14 tables. Ledger is a catalog snapshot manually compared to the displayed PDF, not independently OCR-derived ground truth. Other source anomalies and live edge cases checked separately. Rendering all relevant pages is not exhaustive cell verification.

findings.check: Published neck area 0.785 ft2 times 300 fpm =235.5 cfm, 4.46% above published 225. The next point 315 cfm at 400 fpm is consistent with 314 calculated. This is a source arithmetic concern, not permission to correct 225.
findings.recommendation: Optionally disclose supplier source inconsistency in table notes; do not infer corrected flow.
